_note: ASL ordnance To Hit / To Kill data, transcribed from the eASLRB v3.14 Chapter C divider (C3 To Hit Table, C4 modifications, C7.31-.34 To Kill Tables, C7.7 destruction results, C8.31 HE Equivalency) and the A./G. National Capabilities Chart (Ordnance TH# color). TH#/TK# are 2d6 totals you must roll AT OR UNDER. Range-indexed rows align with the `range_bands` of their section.

th_color._note: A./G. National Capabilities Chart 'Ordnance TH# Color'. American: red before 1944, black 1944+. French vehicles use red. Axis Minor (g)/(t) equipment uses black (A25.83). British Vehicle Note A: some MA uses red pre-44. ATR/MG use black unless captured. Captured/non-qualified use red (C5.8).

to_hit._mods_note: C4 Basic TH# modifications are computed from the rule text (they extend past the printed >54 band): * -1 at >12 (C4.11); L +1 at >12 (C4.12); LL +1 at >12, +2 at >24 (C4.13); <=57mm -1 per 12 hexes or fraction beyond 12 (C4.2); <=40mm a further -1 at >12 (C4.2); APCR/APDS -1 per 12 hexes or fraction beyond 12 (C4.3; German 28LL/40LL use it even firing HE); SMOKE +2 at <=12 (C4.4).

ap._note: C7.31 AP TO KILL TABLE. A value is an int, or {nationality: int, 'default': int}; no default = that size exists only for the listed nationalities. Color-coded duplicates: brown 76L/76LL = Russian/Japanese; grey 90L = Italian; blue 88 = British 25pdr; yellow 88* = Australian Baby 25pdr. Vehicle-Note specials (Grant 75 = 13, Japanese 75* Year-38 = 12) need an explicit basic_tk override. MG/ATR rows are not ordnance TH attacks and are omitted.

case_d._note: Rows by caliber: <=25mm, 37-57mm, >=65mm. null = NA (cannot kill). Calibers in the printed gaps are an assumption: <37mm uses the <=25mm row, 58-64mm the 37-57mm row.

unarmored_final_tk._note: C7.31 UNARMORED TARGET Final TK# by caliber (C7.311; also APCR/APDS per C7.321). Doubled on a CH. Thresholds are the lower bound of each printed bucket (ATR-28mm, 37-57, 65-84, 85-95, 100+).

apcr_apds._note: C7.32. Keys prefixed 'D' are APDS. Brown 76L/76LL = Russian, olive 76L = U.S. German 28LL/40LL always use this table unless firing HE (C7.32). Unarmored target: use the AP unarmored Final TK# (C7.321).

heat._note: C7.33 HEAT TO KILL TABLE, by caliber (any barrel). No Case D (C7.332). Unarmored target Final TK# 11, 22 on a CH (C7.331).

he._note: C7.34 HE TO KILL TABLE (no mortars): use the highest caliber column not exceeding the gun's caliber (C7.34). No Case D (C7.341). Unarmored Final TK# is final (C7.342), doubled on a CH.

he_fp._note: A7 IFT column headers 'FP/mm': ordnance HE FP is the highest column whose mm does not exceed the gun's caliber.

he_equivalency._note: C8.31: AP <37mm = 1 FP, >=37mm = 2 FP (includes APCR/APDS); ordnance HEAT uses the IFT column left of the gun's normal HE FP.
